FAQs:


DETAILED FAQs:

Q: My marketing agency already provides dashboards. Why do I need you?
A: That's not a problem. Your agency focuses on running and optimizing your marketing. I focus on understanding the business behind the numbers. I go beyond ROAS and campaign metrics by connecting your marketing data with product costs, returns, shipping, customer value, and true profitability. This helps reveal what your dashboards may not show: where you're actually making money, where you're losing it, and what you should do next. Your agency optimizes the campaigns. I uncover the business opportunities behind them.

Q: Do I need to have my data perfectly organized before we work together?
A: Absolutely not. Most founders have messy data spread across Shopify, GA4, and ad platforms that don't talk to each other. That's exactly what my Data Setup & Infrastructure service fixes. I handle 100% of the backend engineering (SQL, Python, BigQuery) to clean, merge, and structure your data. You never have to touch a single line of code.

Q: Why is there a separate fee for the Data Setup? Can't you just look at my Shopify dashboard?
A: Shopify's default dashboard only shows about 10% of the picture . To find the hidden profit leaks, I have to pull raw data from all your platforms, align currencies and timezones, and merge them into one central database . This is a one-time investment that pays for itself with every decision you make going forward. You only pay for the platforms you actually use.

Q: Which package should I start with?
A: Most stores start with the E-Commerce Health Check Audit (Standard from $499, 3-5 business days) to identify immediate revenue and profit leaks, then move to E-Commerce Performance Improvement to fix what the audit found. If you already know the problem area, choose a Specialized E-Commerce Audit instead. During a free discovery call we can point you to the right starting point.

Q: I have a specific, urgent problem (like high return rates or declining ad performance). Do I have to buy a full package?
A: No. You don't need to commit to a full package if you only need help solving one specific problem. You can choose one of my Specialized Add-On Audits , such as a CRO Audit, Profitability Audit, Marketing Audit, or another focused audit designed around a specific business issue. These are deep-dive, standalone engagements delivered in 7–14 days . If your problem doesn't fit into a predefined audit, you can also use Part 4: Custom Analytics & Insights . I can build a custom analysis specifically around the business question you need answered, using the data and context relevant to your situation. You pay for the problem you need solved, not for analysis you don't need.

Q: My revenue is growing, but I don't feel like I'm making more money. Can you help?
A: This is the most common scenario I see. Revenue is vanity; profit is sanity. I will run a Profit Reality Check on your top products, calculate your true margins (after COGS, ad spend, returns, and shipping), and show you exactly which "best-sellers" are quietly draining your bank account .

Q: How much of my time is required during the engagement?
A: Very little. I built this process specifically for busy founders. I handle the data extraction, engineering, and analysis. You simply provide initial platform access, and then join me for the final strategy call to review the findings and action plan. You don't need to babysit the project.

Q: I don't have a marketing team. Will I actually be able to implement your recommendations?
A: Absolutely. I make every recommendation simple enough for a founder or small team to understand and implement without needing a technical background or a dedicated marketing team. You won't get complicated instructions or a 50-page technical report. Every finding comes with a clear, prioritized action plan written in plain business language, such as "Pause this ad," "Fix this checkout step," or "Target these high-value customers." And if you still don't have the time, resources, or confidence to implement something yourself, that's exactly what the E-Commerce Performance Improvement service is for — we can implement the fixes together (done-with-you) or handle the implementation for you (done-for-you).

Q: I'm nervous about giving access to my Shopify and ad accounts. Is my data secure?
A: 100% secure. I use strict, permission-based API connections. For live dashboard clients, I store all API keys and tokens securely using environment variables or Secret Manager — never exposed, never at risk. Your data is used solely for your analysis and is never shared .

Q: How fast can we start? I'm bleeding money.
A: The E-Commerce Health Check Audit Standard is delivered in 3-5 business days . If your business is losing $1,690 a month , you don't have 3 months to wait for a consultant to figure it out. You need to know exactly what to fix this week .

Acquiring a new customer costs 5-7x more than retaining an existing one. If customers aren't returning, you're on a treadmill. This audit identifies exactly why customers aren't coming back, and gives you a precise plan to change that. Audit My Retention What's Covered The Scope What This Audit Covers A deep-dive into your customer base to uncover why repeat purchases are lagging. The Purpose To identify the root causes of customer churn and build a data-backed retention strategy. Problems Solved High acquisition costs coupled with flat revenue due to low repeat purchase rates. Decisions Supported Win-back campaigns, loyalty program design, and acquisition channel reallocation. The Outcome After This Package, You Will Know Exactly how to keep your best customers, improve retention, and win back those who are slipping away. Why Customers Leave What behaviors and patterns are linked to customers leaving. Valuable Segments Which customer segments are most valuable and deserve more attention. At-Risk Customers Which customers are showing signs they may leave. Retention Gaps Where your retention is falling short and where improvement is possible. Loyalty Drivers What behaviors and strategies are most likely to bring customers back. LTV Drivers Which customer behaviors and acquisition sources contribute to higher lifetime value. What We Analyze 6 Lenses on Why Customers Leave We map exactly what brings them back using behavioral data. 1 Customer Acquisition Quality Analysis Objective: Identify High-Retention Acquisition Channels Data Analyzed: Acquisition channel vs. repeat purchase behavior. Not all new customers are equal. We analyze which acquisition channels bring customers who return and purchase again versus those who buy once and leave. This reveals which channels are generating stronger retention and long-term customer value. Example Insight: “42% of customers acquired through Google made repeat purchases, compared with only 12% of Facebook-acquired customers. Google is bringing customers with significantly stronger retention potential.” Strategic Recommendation: Prioritize acquisition channels that consistently bring customers with stronger repeat-purchase behavior and long-term value. Google Repeat Rate 42% FB Repeat Rate 12% Google - Loyal 50% FB - One-Time 15% FB - At-Risk 31% 2 Retention Rate Calculation Objective: Understand How Many Customers Come Back Data Analyzed: 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day customer retention. We measure how many customers come back and purchase again after their first purchase. We compare your retention rate with a relevant benchmark to show where you stand and how much additional revenue you could unlock by getting more customers to return. Example Insight: “Only 15% of your customers return within 30 days, compared with a 25% benchmark. Increasing your 30-day retention could unlock significant additional revenue from your existing customers.” Strategic Recommendation: Improve post-purchase follow-ups, personalized offers, and re-engagement campaigns to encourage more customers to purchase again. 30-Day Retention 15% Benchmark 25% Retention Gap -10 PP Benchmark 25% Your Rate 15% 3 Full RFM Customer Segmentation Objective: Understand Customer Behavior & Retention Opportunities Data Analyzed: Recency, Frequency, and Monetary value for all customers. We segment your entire customer base into 8 behavioral groups: Champions, Loyal, Potential Loyalists, At-Risk, Hibernating, Lost, New, and Promising. Each segment receives a specific retention action based on their purchasing behavior. Example Insight: “127 Champions generate 43% of your revenue, while 89 At-Risk customers are showing signs of becoming inactive. Here’s exactly who to retain, re-engage, and win back.” Strategic Recommendation: Reward Champions and Loyal customers, nurture Potential Loyalists, and launch targeted win-back campaigns for At-Risk and Lost customers. Champions 127 Loyal 312 Potential 185 Promising 246 New 198 At-Risk 89 Hibernating 164 Lost 410 4 Churn Pattern Analysis Objective: Identify Customers Likely to Leave Data Analyzed: Purchase history, purchase frequency, recency, and engagement behavior of customers who stop buying. We identify the common behaviors and patterns that appear before customers stop purchasing. This helps us find customers who are showing strong signs of leaving, so you can reach them before they become inactive. Example Insight: “Customers who haven't purchased in 90+ days and previously bought only once are significantly more likely to leave. These customers should be prioritized for re-engagement.” Strategic Recommendation: Trigger targeted re-engagement offers when customers begin showing strong signs of leaving. Active Customers 850 Churn Risk 89 High-Risk 34 Avg Days Last Pur. 94 D Active 850 Churn Risk 89 High-Risk 34 5 Customer Behavior Flow Analysis Objective: Understand What Customers Do Between Purchases Data Analyzed: Customer browsing, product views, and cart activity between purchases. We track what customers do after their purchase and before they buy again, including what they browse, what they add to cart but don't purchase, and where they stop engaging. This helps us understand what may be preventing customers from coming back. Example Insight: “400 customers are browsing products without adding anything to their cart, while 120 customers are adding products but leaving without purchasing. Audit My Catalog What's Covered The Scope What This Audit Covers A complete product portfolio blueprint to identify what to grow, optimize, reprice, bundle, or remove. The Purpose To evaluate every product across profitability, sales performance, pricing, inventory efficiency, returns, and growth potential, so your product decisions are backed by data. Problems Solved Low-margin products, inefficient inventory, dead stock, unnecessary return costs, weak pricing, and missed cross-sell and bundle opportunities. Decisions Supported Product growth or discontinuation, pricing adjustments, inventory investment, dead stock clearance, return reduction, and bundle creation. The Outcome After This Package, You Will Know Every product opportunity identified. Every important decision prioritized. Top Product Drivers Which products and categories contribute the most value. True Profitability Which products are actually profitable after key costs. Pricing Opportunities Which products may have room for profitable price adjustments. Inventory Efficiency Where you're overstocked, understocked, or tying up unnecessary cash. Dead Stock Which products are holding cash and should be cleared, bundled, or discontinued. Bundle Opportunities Which products can be combined to increase AOV and create additional revenue. Cost Savings Where you can reduce unnecessary product, inventory, return, and operational costs. Growth Opportunities Which products and categories deserve more investment for profitable growth. Catalog Analysis 8 Catalog Analyses A complete deep-dive into your product portfolio. 1 ABC Product Classification Objective: Identify Your Most and Least Valuable Products Data Analyzed: Revenue contribution and sales performance of each SKU. We classify every product in your catalog into three tiers based on its contribution to your business: A-Tier products that drive the most value, B-Tier products that need optimization, and C-Tier products that contribute the least and may need to be reduced or discontinued. Example Insight: “Your A-Tier products generate the majority of revenue, while many C-Tier products contribute little but continue to tie up inventory and cash.” Strategic Recommendation: Protect and grow high-value A-Tier products, optimize B-Tier products, and review C-Tier products for potential reduction or discontinuation. A-Tier Top 20% B-Tier Mid 30% C-Tier Low 50% 2 Product-Level Profit Margin Analysis Objective: Find Your True Product Profitability Data Analyzed: COGS, shipping costs, return costs, discounts, and proportional marketing costs per product. We calculate the true profit margin of each product after accounting for the costs that are often missed when looking at revenue alone. This reveals which products are genuinely profitable and which top sellers may be quietly reducing your overall profit. Example Insight: “Product A generates strong revenue but has only a 5% true profit margin, while Product B delivers a 45% margin. Your highest-selling products aren't always your most profitable.” Strategic Recommendation: Reprice, bundle, or reduce marketing spend on low-margin products to protect and improve overall profitability. 4. UTM & Source/Medium Tracking Review - Objective: Improve Traffic-Source Classification. Consistent UTM naming, paid/email appearing as Direct.
5. Attribution Difference & Privacy Limitation Review - Objective: Explain Limits Behind Reported Performance. iOS privacy, consent, attribution windows, click vs view-through.
6. Tracking Correction Roadmap - Objective: Turn Findings Into an Implementation Plan (carried into Phase 2). Each issue with impact, correction, responsible party, validation. Priority levels: Critical/High/Medium/Low.

WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE (15 deliverables across 3 phases):
Phase 1 (Audit Outputs): 01 Marketing Measurement Audit Report, 02 Platform Reconciliation Matrix, 03 Event Tracking Health Summary.
Phase 2 (Implementation Outputs): 04 Configured & Deployed GTM Container, 05 GA4 + Meta Pixel + CAPI Implementation, 06 Google Ads Conversion Tracking, 07 UTM Naming & Standardization Framework, 08 Duplicate & Incorrect Tracking Correction, 09 Server-Side Deduplication.
Phase 3 (Verification & Handover Outputs): 10 Test Purchase Verification Report, 11 GA4 DebugView & Meta Events Manager Validation, 12 Shopify vs GA4 Reconciliation Check, 13 Final Documentation & Handover Guide, 14 45-Minute Walkthrough Call, 15 14-Day Post-Handover Support.

WHY END-TO-END (vs Audit-Only): Audit-only gives a report you must then implement yourself, with no proof numbers match afterwards. End-to-end fixes everything and proves it with test purchases — no handoff gap between diagnosis and repair, plus documentation your team can maintain.

OPTIONAL ADD-ON (separate engagement, not in base price):
- Optional Ongoing Measurement Dashboard: Shopify order baseline, GA4 purchase tracking, platform conversion comparison, revenue reconciliation, tracking issue monitoring, channel data-quality indicators, custom KPI views. Automated refresh depends on platform access/connector availability.

FAQ:
- Who is this for: e-commerce brands using Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google Ads whose reported numbers do not align and who want it fixed end-to-end, not just diagnosed.
- Platforms included: Shopify, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and up to two major platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Klaviyo). Additional platforms may require custom quote.
- Will numbers match exactly: Not necessarily. Different attribution rules, windows, consent. Goal is technically correct tracking with deduplication in place and a clear understanding of remaining differences. Shopify = reliable store-sales baseline.
- Implementation included: YES. This is an end-to-end service. Phase 2 implements all fixes (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CAPI, Google Ads, UTM, duplicate-event correction) and Phase 3 verifies with test purchases.
- Ad management included: No. This is measurement/attribution implementation, not paid-media management.
- Data access: Shopify admin, GA4, GTM, Meta Events Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, website theme/checkout, tracking docs. Phase 2 may require collaborator/edit access to GTM, GA4, store theme.
- Timeline: 3-4 weeks (15-20 business days) after access and data are available. Phase 1: 3-5 days, Phase 2: 7-10 days, Phase 3: 3-5 days.
- Complex setups: Multi-platform, headless, multi-store, or complex server-side may require expanded scope and custom quote after Phase 1 audit.

E-commerce Platforms Meta Ads Merge Logic BigQuery DB Live Dashboard Technical Scope What We Build The core engineering components that transform raw data from multiple platforms into a unified, analysis-ready database. 1. Multi-Platform Merge Logic Purpose: Create a Single Source of Truth by connecting data from multiple business platforms. What We Configure: SQL and Python logic to join data from platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant sources using unified identifiers such as Order ID, Customer ID, Product ID, User ID, and Date. Why It Matters: Without proper merge logic, your business data remains in separate silos. We connect the relevant data so you can analyze relationships such as: Ad Spend → Customers → Orders → Revenue → Profit inside one unified data environment. # Multi-Platform Merge Logic SELECT s.order_id, s.revenue, a.ad_spend FROM shopify.orders s JOIN meta.ads a ON s.date = a.date 2. BigQuery Load Script Purpose: Persist your data in the cloud data warehouse. What We Configure: Automated scripts that load cleaned and merged data into structured BigQuery tables. Why It Matters: Moves your processed data into a permanent, queryable database structure, making it ready for reliable analysis, reporting, dashboards, and future data workflows. Clean Data Load Script BigQuery 3. Dashboard Data-Source Connection Purpose: Connect your centralized business data directly to your dashboard so your reports stay updated without repeated manual uploads. What We Configure: We connect your cloud data warehouse or database, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or other supported data environments, to reporting platforms such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or other compatible BI tools. Example Flow: E-commerce Data ↓ Cloud Data Warehouse ↓ Power BI / Looker Studio ↓ Interactive Dashboard Example dashboard metrics: • Revenue & Profit • Product Performance • Customer Segments • Marketing Spend & ROAS • Conversion Rate • Inventory Levels • Customer LTV • Sales Trends Why It Matters: Instead of exporting CSV files every time, your dashboard reads directly from your connected data warehouse. This creates a centralized, connected, and reliable reporting workflow. Example: A store's daily sales data is loaded into the cloud database. Power BI or Looker Studio automatically reads that data and updates dashboards showing revenue, profit, product performance, customer analytics, and marketing performance. Credential Security Purpose: Protect your business data and API credentials from unauthorized access. What We Configure: API keys, access tokens, and other sensitive credentials are securely stored using appropriate methods such as secure environment variables or supported secret management systems. Credentials are never hardcoded directly into scripts. Why It Matters: Secure credential handling reduces the risk of accidental exposure, unauthorized access, and compromised data connections while keeping your connected platforms protected. # Secure Credential Storage import os from secret_manager import access_secret # Credentials loaded securely API_KEY = os.getenv("API_KEY") DB_TOKEN = access_secret("db-token") # No hardcoded credentials # No plaintext secrets in scripts The Transformation Without Proper Data Infrastructure vs With Our Infrastructure Without Setup Disconnected Platforms Duplicate Data Entries Manual CSV Exports Scattered Information With Full Pipeline Unified Master Table Single Source of Truth Centralized BigQuery DB Live Dashboard Connection Business Impact What This Means For Your Business Scalable Analytics A reliable data environment built to handle growing volumes of historical, customer, product, marketing, and operational data.
